title: A cloud becomes clearer
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Dust blocks and scatters visible light strongly in many regions. Some infrared wavelengths pass through those clouds more effectively, revealing features otherwise obscured.

misconception: A learner may choose: Infrared destroys all cosmic dust
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why can infrared observations reveal some objects hidden by cosmic dust in visible-light images?
